name: Text Counter
description: Count the words, characters, letters and lines of any text.

name: Interface Capture
description: Capture and export AXON's real interfaces.

name: Content Extractor
description: Extract and organize useful content.

name: Link Analyzer
description: Analyze links and detect what they lead to.

name: Background Proof
description: Prove background execution with native heartbeats while the app is closed.

name: AI Assistant
description: Get help from AXON's AI.

name: Collage Maker
description: Make a collage from pictures, with a style choice.

name: Picture to Table or Code
description: Turn a picture into a table (CSV) or a drawing (SVG).

name: Audio Converter
description: Convert sound files between formats.

name: Text to Speech
description: Read any text aloud in a voice you choose.

name: Voice Library
description: Many voices, with pitch, speed, style and emotion you can adjust.

name: Voice Cloner
description: Clone a voice you have permission to use, with adjustable speech patterns.

name: Speech to Text
description: Turn speech or audio into text.

name: Video Frames
description: Extract pictures from a video as a zip archive.
purposes: Plan frame selections, output names, size estimates and bounded frame runs without decoding video.
examples: Plan one frame every 2 seconds from a video.
Select specific frame numbers and a time range.

name: Video Converter
description: Convert video between formats.

name: Video Maker
description: Turn a finished edit into a video.

name: Video Downloader
description: Download a video you have the right to keep from a link.

name: File Converter
description: Convert a file from one format to another.
purposes: Identify supported files, offer valid output formats, and explain conversion changes before conversion.
examples: Check what a JSON file can become.
Plan a PNG to WebP conversion.

name: Zip and Unzip
description: Pack files into a zip, or open one.
purposes: Create, list and safely extract ZIP archives with path and resource limits.
examples: List files inside a ZIP archive
Extract one named file from a ZIP

name: PDF Tools
description: Make, read, merge and split PDF files.

name: Document Converter
description: Convert Word and similar documents to text, PDF or Markdown.

name: Batch Convert
description: Convert many files in one go.
purposes: Plan one-target conversions for multiple files, track safe execution, and produce a report and ZIP-ready outputs.
examples: Convert a group of CSV files to JSON.
Plan a batch of pictures for WebP output.

name: File Inspector
description: Show a file's type, size and a summary of what is inside.
purposes: Identify file types and inspect header bytes without opening or executing files.
examples: Identify a file from its first bytes.
Show a hex dump and image dimensions.

name: File Compare
description: Compare any two files and see how many differences there are and where.
purposes: Compare file bytes, text lines, or decoded image pixels and report differences.
examples: Compare two files byte for byte.
Show which text lines changed.

name: Unit & Base Converter
description: Convert lengths, weights, temperatures and other units, and number bases.
purposes: Read and write bounded delimited tables with quoted fields and explicit row-shape warnings.
Read and write XML using AXON’s documented plain-value convention.
Read and write a safe, documented YAML subset as plain values.
Plan image output names, dimensions, transparency handling, and quality without decoding or converting pixels.

inputs.name: rootName
inputs.prompt: Optional root element name when writing

examples: Read this CSV table
Convert these rows to TSV

name: Find and Replace
description: Find text and replace it, with a preview first.
purposes: Find literal or regular-expression matches and replace selected or all occurrences, within the engine limits.
examples: Replace every “cat” with “dog”.
Find case-sensitive matches and report their positions.

name: Case Converter
description: Change text to upper, lower, title or sentence case.
purposes: Convert text between supported letter-case and identifier styles.
examples: Convert a title to camelCase.
Make a sentence UPPER case.

name: Text Cleaner
description: Remove extra spaces, blank lines and duplicate lines.
purposes: Clean whitespace, blank lines, line endings, zero-width characters and selected punctuation in text.
examples: Trim spaces at the start and end of each line.
Remove blank lines and normalize line endings.

name: Sort Lines
description: Sort lines of text and remove duplicates.
purposes: Sort, reverse, deduplicate or filter lines; shuffle requires injected randomness.
examples: Sort these lines alphabetically.
Sort lines by length and remove duplicates.

name: Text Compare
description: Show the differences between two texts.
purposes: Compare two text values by line or word and report same, added and removed tokens.
examples: Compare two versions line by line.
Show word-level changes between two passages.

name: Rephraser
description: Say a sentence in other words, with versions to choose from.

name: Grammar Helper
description: Explain how a sentence is built and point out mistakes.

name: Calculator
description: Work out sums, with the steps shown.
purposes: Evaluate a bounded mathematical expression with explicit degree or radian angle mode.
examples: Calculate (12 + 8) / 4.
Evaluate sin(30) in degree mode.

name: Number to Words
description: Write a number in words, and back.
purposes: Spell supported numeric input as words, with optional ordinal form.
examples: Write 1250 in words.
Spell 21 as an ordinal.

name: Percentage Helper
description: Work out percentages, changes and shares.
purposes: Calculate percent-of, what-percent, percent change, adjustment and percent-of-what operations.

inputs.name: values
inputs.prompt: Provide the numeric values required by the selected mode.

examples: Find 15 percent of 240.
Calculate the percentage change from 80 to 92.

name: Timer
description: Count down from a time you choose.
purposes: Manage timer state with caller-supplied timestamps; it does not schedule background callbacks.

inputs.name: now
inputs.prompt: Timestamp in milliseconds supplied by the caller.

examples: Start a 90-second timer.
Pause or resume a running timer.

name: Stopwatch
description: Time something, with laps.
purposes: Manage stopwatch state and laps using caller-supplied timestamps; it does not run a live clock itself.

inputs.name: now
inputs.prompt: Timestamp in milliseconds supplied by the caller.

examples: Start a stopwatch at a supplied timestamp.
Record a lap and total elapsed time.

name: Date Calculator
description: Add or subtract days, or find the days between two dates.
purposes: Parse calendar dates and calculate date differences, offsets, weekdays, day-of-year, ISO weeks and weekdays in a range.
examples: Add 30 days to a date.
Find the number of days between two dates.

name: Tally Counter
description: Keep a running total with one tap.
purposes: Manage named bounded counters with increments, decrements, set, reset and undo operations.
examples: Create a counter named visitors.
Decrease the visitor tally by one.

name: QR Code Maker
description: Turn text or a link into a QR code.
purposes: Create standards-based QR codes for text, links, contact details and Wi-Fi.
examples: Encode a website link as a QR code.
Create a QR code for a Wi-Fi network.

name: Password Generator
description: Make strong passwords of the length you choose.
purposes: Generate a password from explicit options using an injected random source or the available cryptographic source.

inputs.name: random
inputs.prompt: Optional injected random provider for deterministic tests.

examples: Generate a 20-character password.
Create a password that includes symbols.

name: Random Picker
description: Pick random numbers, names or items from a list.
purposes: Pick, shuffle, roll dice, flip a coin, choose random integers or split items into teams with an injectable random source.

inputs.name: random
inputs.prompt: Optional injected random provider for deterministic tests.

examples: Pick three names from a list.
Roll 2d6.

name: Encoder and Decoder
description: Convert text to and from Base64, URL and hexadecimal.
purposes: Encode or decode text using supported Base64, Base64URL, URL, HTML, hex, binary and ROT13 formats.
examples: Encode text as Base64.
Decode a percent-encoded URL value.

name: Hash and Checksum
description: Work out the checksum of a text or a file.
purposes: Calculate supported digest or checksum values for text or bytes using the supplied digest provider.
examples: Calculate a SHA-256 digest of text.
Compute a CRC32 checksum.

name: Dictionary
description: Look up words, with history, bookmarks, notes and a word of the day.

name: My Dictionary
description: Import word lists with meanings from a file and keep them as your own data.
purposes: Keep, search, import with confirmation, export and erase the owner’s own word meanings separately from the English dictionary.
examples: Add a word to my dictionary
Find entries in my dictionary

name: Document Reader
description: Open long text files and search inside them.
purposes: Turns supported text documents into bounded readable blocks with outline, statistics and search.
examples: Open a Markdown document and show its headings.
Search this CSV for a value.

name: Translator
description: Translate between languages, one language at a time as they are added.

name: Summarizer
description: Shorten a long text and keep what matters.
purposes: Selects important original sentences without rewriting them.
examples: Summarize this article in five sentences.
Extract the key sentences from these notes.

name: JSON and Data Viewer
description: Open JSON and tables and look through them.
purposes: Validate, indent or minify JSON without changing number literals or duplicate keys.
Inspect valid JSON as a bounded, lazy tree with paths and structural statistics.
examples: [1e5,true]

name: Web Search
description: Search the web from the chat.

name: AXON Code
description: Write code, test it safely and report what passed.

name: Code Formatter
description: Tidy code so it is easy to read.
purposes: Pretty-print or minify JSON, CSS, HTML and XML while preserving meaningful content.
examples: Pretty-print nested JSON
Minify a CSS stylesheet

name: Pattern Tester
description: Try a text pattern (regular expression) and see what it matches.
purposes: Test JavaScript regular expressions against text and inspect matches or replacements.

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.prompt: Enter a JavaScript regular expression pattern.

inputs.name: flags
inputs.prompt: Optional flags: g, i, m, s, u, y.

examples: Find every number in a text
Check whether a pattern matches a line

name: Currency Converter
description: Convert between currencies using rates you can see.

name: Loan Calculator
description: Work out repayments and the total cost.
purposes: Calculate amortized loan payments and repayment schedules
examples: Calculate a 5 year loan
Show savings from extra payments

name: Split and Tip
description: Share a bill between people, with a tip.
purposes: Split bills and tips fairly in cents
examples: Split a bill among three people
Split using two parts and one part

name: Market Scope
description: Study markets (built separately, joined to AXON later).

name: Device Profile
description: Show what this phone can carry: memory, storage and Android version.
purposes: Report device and app details supplied by the environment, without guessing missing values.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.prompt: Device environment values are supplied by the app.

examples: Copy the current device profile
Check the reported browser version

name: Backup and Restore
description: Save your AXON data, or bring it back.

name: Settings
description: Open AXON Settings.

name: Taught Meanings
description: Teach AXON what a word or phrase means, list what was taught, forget one meaning or all of them.

name: AXON Source
description: Export the AXON source project.
